entries.source_note: Monthly investor and early-contributor tranche. Figure carried here is Tokenomist's: 36,820,000 EIGEN (Investors 19,750,000 + Early Contributors 17,070,000), reported as 4.93% of circulating supply in Token Unlocks data carried by PANews/Binance (Oct 25, 2026); about $7.3M at Oct 25 prices. CONTESTED on size: DefiLlama's emissions model puts the same Nov 1 tranche at 37,825,418 EIGEN, and DefiLlama's unlocks list dates a ~$7.31M EIGEN unlock Oct 31, 2026 (UTC boundary). The desk resolves the size from the Eigen Foundation's own vesting disclosures before any edition relies on it. Weekly programmatic emissions (about 1.29M EIGEN/week) are a separate flow, not this event.

Early-November monthly release window (Oct 31 – Nov 1). Figure carried here is the aggregated multi-tranche total reported from Token Unlocks data (PANews/Binance, Oct 25, 2026): about 13,150,000 SUI on Nov 1, 2026, 0.32% of circulating supply. CONTESTED: trackers count different recipient tranches — DefiLlama's Sui Foundation page lists a single tranche of 2,070,000 SUI to Mysten Labs Treasury on Oct 31, 2026 (0.05% of circulating supply), while Tokenomist dates the next release Nov 1, 2026 to the Community Reserve. The desk resolves tranche composition from the Sui Foundation's published token schedule before any edition relies on it. Release type left unstated: the trackers characterize this instalment differently.

Monthly Foundation tranche. SECONDARY-CORROBORATED (labelled as such): Ethena's docs publish no vesting terms for the Foundation allocation, so the date and amount rest on Tokenomist's structured Ethena data (next unlock Nov 2, 2026: 40,625,000 ENA to the Foundation), corroborated by two independent reports of the original schedule (Odaily; Coinlook: Foundation tranche about 40,625,000 ENA monthly, released on the 2nd). Share is 40,625,000 of the 15,000,000,000 total supply. This entry replaces the previously carried 275,015,625 ENA Nov 1 figure, which the desk withdrew on 2026-10-25 after primary-source verification (see the Core Contributors entry).

Monthly Core Contributors tranche. DERIVED FROM PROJECT DOCS (labelled as such): arithmetic from Ethena's own published vesting terms (docs.ethena.fi): Core Contributors hold 30% of the 15,000,000,000 total supply = 4,500,000,000 ENA, on a 1-year 25% cliff then 3-year linear monthly vesting from TGE (Mar 5, 2024) — the post-cliff 3,375,000,000 over 36 monthly payments is 93,750,000 ENA, released on the 5th. The Ethena Foundation's Aug 27, 2026 ecosystem update confirms team tokens remain on this original schedule, and that all remaining investor unlocks were accelerated into a single release on Oct 5, 2026 — no investor tokens remain locked. The previously carried 275,015,625 ENA 'Nov 1 unlock' figure was traced to an aggregator artifact, is not reproducible from any primary source, and is withdrawn.

Final tranche of Jito's original multi-year vesting schedule. Figures from the desk's published audit of Jito (Oct 24, 2026): total supply 1,000,000,000 JTO; 986,522,404 on-chain; circulating 535,820,549 (53.6%); mint and freeze authority both revoked. Figures re-verified the morning Unlock Watch Edition 002 publishes (Nov 7, 2026).

First monthly release under Aptos' reduced schedule: core contributor and investor vesting ended Oct 12, 2026, cutting the monthly release from about 11,310,000 to 4,540,000 APT. Date, amount, and the 0.51% of circulating supply agree across DefiLlama's Aptos unlocks page and Tokenomist (both read Oct 25, 2026); recipient split of Community 3,210,000 + Foundation 1,330,000 per CoinGecko's Aptos tokenomics page. Linear monthly instalment; the reduced rate continues on the same cadence.

Monthly cliff instalment to Team, Future Team + Advisors and Investors. The amount agrees exactly across both trackers: 92,645,834 ARB (Tokenomist; DefiLlama states 92.65M), at 1.34% of circulating supply (DefiLlama). CONTESTED on date by one day: Tokenomist and the 16th-of-month cadence (the prior instalment fell Oct 16, 2026) give Nov 16, 2026; DefiLlama's Arbitrum unlocks page states Nov 15, 2026. The desk resolves the date from the Arbitrum Foundation's vesting disclosures before any edition relies on it. Same-size instalments continue monthly until March 2027.

Next dated release in LayerZero's monthly cliff cycle, to insider tranches. Figures from the desk's published audit of LayerZero (Oct 24, 2026): total and maximum supply 1,000,000,000 ZRO; circulating 399,976,128 (40.0%); top-10 holders 38.2% of total supply; DEX liquidity $796,643. Figures re-verified the morning Unlock Watch Edition 003 publishes (Nov 20, 2026).
